scope: All 360 A2.2–B2.2 activities; surface load and internal reference QA, not a native-speaker review.
limitations: Word counts and first-seen surface forms cannot measure lexical knowledge: conjugated forms can be new while the verb is familiar. No automatic vocabulary gap claim is made.
No automatic grammar or CEFR certification is inferred.
Flags require contextual educator judgement; no blanket simplification of B2.
